dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: (An ancient stone carving, with rough patterns cut into it by what appears to be a knife...)

dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: "I will leave the first knife mark here, to engrave the halls of this darkened world for those that come after me."

dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: "This is where I make my first call to the night, that those who come after may summon from this departed world the glory of our ancestral spirits."

dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: "Reach out, those who would follow in my footsteps..."

dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: "And leave here your mark on history!"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text:
You see, appearing before your eyes... the figures of heroes who have come before.
A man with flaming hair whose smile beams brightly, a travel-worn youth whose eyes smolder like the sunset, a child with an Iktomisaurus whose brow is furrowed in thought...
And there, a familiar silhouette. She pauses but for the briefest of moments, then plunges resolutely into five hundred years of solitude.
Some faces appear solemn, others mournful, while some still carry a flicker of anger, despite arriving at this place.
Yet without exception, they all stand there. Without exception, they have all ended up leaving "themselves" in this place...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Countless hands stretch out from the darkness, each clutching glowing stone feathers, passing them one by one into the distance.\nSome are swallowed by the darkness, but some still remain as unquenchable flames that adorn the curtain of night like stars.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You know that these are "names." And one of them belongs to you.

dialogues.speaker: Record of an Ancient Fool
dialogues.text: (The stone tablet remains as dark as ever, but you know that, somewhere on its surface, you have left an indelible mark...)
